metadata.case_name: WONG YUK FOON v. NICE PROPERTY MANAGEMENT LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: Security guard (Express Security Limited); part-time Customer Service Centre Assistant for MTR Corporation
plaintiff.occupation_after: General worker in a restaurant (March 2006); Service attendant in a private club (from September 2007)

injuries.description: fracture in the 5th metatarsal bone in the left foot
source: fracture of the bone in the small toe of her left foot.
fracture in the 5th metatarsal bone in the left foot.

manifestations.description: Residual but permanent pain in her left foot, particularly when she sits, stands or walks for a prolonged period of time.
The pain would also disturb her sleep.
She has to take rest from time to time after prolonged sitting, standing or walking.

losses.description: Residual but permanent pain in left foot, particularly when she sits, stands or walks for a prolonged period of time; pain disturbs her sleep; mild left calf muscle wasting; needs rest from time to time after prolonged sitting, standing or walking.

Reduced earning capacity and a real risk of financial disadvantage in the labour market because of residual pain causing inconvenience in work and greater difficulty finding suitable work if dismissed.

comparable_cases.case_name: To Ying Wa v Cargo-Land (Warehouse) Devlopment Ltd.
comparable_cases.injury_description: The plaintiffs there suffered fractures of similar bones in their feet and obtained damages for PSLA in the region of $150,000 and $200,000.
